import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Calculate age and total spending
df['Age'] = 2024 - df['Year_Birth']
df['Total_Spending'] = (df['MntWines'] + df['MntFruits'] + df['MntMeatProducts'] + 
                        df['MntFishProducts'] + df['MntSweetProducts'] + df['MntGoldProds'])

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Income vs Total Spending by Education
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
education_order = df.groupby('Education')['Total_Spending'].median().sort_values(ascending=False).index
for edu in education_order:
    subset = df[df['Education'] == edu]
    ax1.scatter(subset['Income'], subset['Total_Spending'], alpha=0.5, label=edu, s=30)
ax1.set_xlabel('Income', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Spending', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Income vs Total Spending by Education Level', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax1.legend(title='Education', fontsize=9)
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Age Distribution
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
ax2.hist(df['Age'], bins=30, color='steelblue', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax2.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Spending by Category
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
spending_categories = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 
                       'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
spending_means = [df[cat].mean() for cat in spending_categories]
labels = ['Wines', 'Fruits', 'Meat', 'Fish', 'Sweets', 'Gold']
colors = plt.cm.Set3(range(len(labels)))
ax3.barh(labels, spending_means, color=colors, edgecolor='black', alpha=0.8)
ax3.set_xlabel('Average Spending', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Average Spending by Category', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax3.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Purchase Channels
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
purchase_channels = ['NumWebPurchases', 'NumCatalogPurchases', 'NumStorePurchases', 'NumDealsPurchases']
purchase_totals = [df[ch].sum() for ch in purchase_channels]
labels_ch = ['Web', 'Catalog', 'Store', 'Deals']
colors_ch = plt.cm.Pastel1(range(len(labels_ch)))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax4.pie(purchase_totals, labels=labels_ch, autopct='%1.1f%%',
                                     colors=colors_ch, startangle=90)
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('black')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')
    autotext.set_fontsize(10)
ax4.set_title('Purchase Distribution by Channel', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10)

# 5. Marital Status vs Income
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
marital_order = df.groupby('Marital_Status')['Income'].median().sort_values(ascending=False).index
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['Income'])
marital_data = [df_clean[df_clean['Marital_Status'] == status]['Income'].values for status in marital_order]
bp = ax5.boxplot(marital_data, labels=marital_order, patch_artist=True)
for patch in bp['boxes']:
    patch.set_facecolor('lightcoral')
    patch.set_alpha(0.7)
ax5.set_xlabel('Marital Status', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Income', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Income by Marital Status', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax5.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax5.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 6. Kids at Home vs Total Spending
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
df['Total_Kids'] = df['Kidhome'] + df['Teenhome']
kids_spending = df.groupby('Total_Kids')['Total_Spending'].mean()
ax6.bar(kids_spending.index, kids_spending.values, color='skyblue', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.8)
ax6.set_xlabel('Number of Kids at Home', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_ylabel('Average Total Spending', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_title('Average Spending by Number of Kids', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax6.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 7. Campaign Acceptance Rates
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
campaigns = ['AcceptedCmp1', 'AcceptedCmp2', 'AcceptedCmp3', 'AcceptedCmp4', 'AcceptedCmp5', 'Response']
acceptance_rates = [(df[cmp].sum() / len(df)) * 100 for cmp in campaigns]
labels_cmp = ['Cmp1', 'Cmp2', 'Cmp3', 'Cmp4', 'Cmp5', 'Last']
colors_cmp = plt.cm.viridis(np.linspace(0, 0.9, len(labels_cmp)))
ax7.bar(labels_cmp, acceptance_rates, color=colors_cmp, edgecolor='black', alpha=0.8)
ax7.set_xlabel('Campaign', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_ylabel('Acceptance Rate (%)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_title('Campaign Acceptance Rates', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax7.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 8. Recency vs Web Visits
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
ax8.scatter(df['Recency'], df['NumWebVisitsMonth'], alpha=0.4, c='darkorange', s=20)
ax8.set_xlabel('Recency (Days)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_ylabel('Web Visits per Month', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_title('Recency vs Web Activity', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax8.grid(alpha=0.3)

plt.suptitle('Customer Segmentation Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
